pausedSub: Chofoza noma ucindezele u-Enter ukuze uqhubeke.
emptySub: Engeza okuqukethwe kulo mdlalo ukuze udlalwe.
copyFail: Umbhalo ukhethiwe. Wukopishe nge-Ctrl noma i-Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Umdlalo wezwe. Hambisa isiqephu. Imiqondo izokuphonsa inselelo ngemibuzo.
stageHow: Hamba ngemicibisholo noma ngo-W A S D. Cindezela u-N ukuze uye endlini elandelayo. Uma kuvela umqondo, cindezela u-1 kuya ku-4 noma u-Tab no-Enter ukuze uphendule. Cindezela u-Tab ukuze uqhubekele phambili. Umbhalo ogcwele futhi ungaphansi kokuthi Funda ungadlali.
hintKeys: Imicibisholo noma i-WASD ukuhamba. U-N wendlu elandelayo.
guideText: Hamba ungena. Imiqondo izokuthola, noma ungqongqoze endlini evaliwe ukuze uhlangane nomunye.
knockedOut: Uwile! Uhoxile. Izinhliziyo zakho ziyabuya, ngakho zama futhi.
knockedDialog: U-{name} ubalekile. Ngqongqoza endlini yawo ukuze umbhekane futhi.
